business_problem: Medtronic employees work under different country, contract, and regulatory arrangements, making a single HR knowledge base insufficient. The company needed a relevant, self-service way to answer routine HR questions and complete tasks for a global, largely deskless workforce.
solution_summary: Medtronic launched HRmony, an AI assistant built on Moveworks and delivered through ServiceNow HR Service Delivery. HRmony grounds responses in Medtronic's organizational structure, policy library, Workday, and business rules so it can personalize answers and complete routine tasks. For performance goal setting, an employee describes priorities in conversation; the assistant creates structured goals, asks for approval to submit them to Workday, notifies the manager, summarizes the goals, and offers meeting times. Routine cases can be submitted, resolved, and closed end to end, while questions requiring judgment are routed to people. Manufacturing employees can reach HRmony through QR codes at sites without leaving the production floor. More than 60 use cases were live within the first year.

data_flow: HRmony uses Medtronic's org chart, policy library, Workday, and rules to interpret an employee request; it prepares a response or task, requests approval where needed, updates Workday, and routes complex cases to human staff.
business_outcome: HRmony deflects 80% of HR tickets, has saved 6,000 hours, and supports employees across the global workforce. More than 60 AI use cases were in production within the first year, with human judgment retained for complex matters.
